intro: Our first week: tldrcve went live on 19 Nov 2026. Ten pages we launched with carry publish dates before 16 Nov, so they show under updates rather than as new.

changed: Added a note on CVE-2026-39919, another Ghostscript bug the same update fixes, and a warning that the 10.08.0 release candidate isn't fixed.

Clearer that the crafted file can be uploaded as an image, or, the researcher says, a video. Notes the five other CVEs 10.08.0 fixes. The write-up is dated 17 Nov but first went public on 21 Nov, per oss-security.

Now says to update right away if outsiders' files reach Ghostscript: the public proof of concept and write-up cover most of an exploit, and the researchers say a full exploit comes next. Scare 2.9. Added what would make this Patch now.

Corrected: the researchers' write-up includes a downloadable proof-of-concept file (it takes control of memory but doesn't run commands by itself); we had said no exploit was public. Added Amazon Linux, SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7 and 16, and openSUSE Leap 16, which have no fixed package yet, and Ubuntu's conflicting tracker status. Disclosure date set to 8 Sep, when the fix was released (the CVE record says 2 Sep, when the fix was written).
CISA added CVE-2026-129448 to its exploited list (KEV) on 20 Nov, due 23 Nov; we'd still said it wasn't listed. Scare 3.6.
Rechecked: still no stable kernel with the fix, and it isn't queued for the next stable releases. Gentoo and a Fedora Rawhide test build carry it.

Renamed from "iTerm2 cat RCE" to match the researcher's new title, Arbitrary Command Execution: you have to display the attacker's file, so it isn't remote in the usual sense. The researcher's affected range now matches ours. The address stays the same.
Added Safe versions. Citrix has since released newer builds (14.1-73.58, 13.1-64.39).
Added Istio 1.32 to Safe versions (Istio lists 1.32.0 and later as patched).
The 19 Nov releases also close two gaps PHP found in the October fix (CVE-2026-129481, CVE-2026-129182). Links to the new PHP 19 Nov release page.

Now lists all ten CVEs fixed by the 18 Nov releases, with a bug list. "Are you affected?" covers the HTTP/3, resolver, mail proxy and TLS 1.3 bugs, not only HTTP/2. Corrected the affected NGINX Plus range (37.2.x is affected too).
Dropped a conflicting Alpine 3.19 tracker version (the package index matches the advisory). Safe versions added.
Still no fixed release (newest v0.5.23). Partial fixes merged on 7 and 14 Nov, not yet released; this explains the docs conflict. Safe versions added.
Rechecked: no fixed GitLab, GitHub Enterprise Server or Chatwoot release yet; Veria's 25 Nov plan unchanged.
Veria moved its exploit release to 25 Nov (later if vendors haven't shipped fixes). Safe versions added.
Puppet Core 8.22.2 (Puppet Server 8.9.13) fixes it on the 8.x line.
Puppet Core 9.1.3 (Puppet Server 9.0.24.1) fixes it. OpenVox Server 9.1.1 / 8.17.1 count as affected too. Safe versions added.
PHP 8.6.0 added. A public exploit for a test lab is out (uses a planted gadget class): exploit status set to public. Debian packages out. Safe versions added.
Current Channel 2611 (17 Nov) is now the newest build. Safe versions added.
Rechecked: the fix is still unmerged and on hold for discussion; no OpenSSL rating yet.
Points to the Linux SCTP root page for the kernel bug Xint chained it with.
Added CVE-2026-123633 (second HTTP/2 bug, same fix) and the other nginx bugs fixed by the same releases; Debian DLA-4918-1.
APISIX 3.21.0 and NGINX Gateway Fabric 2.9.0 include the fix; NGINX Ingress Controller 5.8.0 doesn't yet. Debian and Ubuntu packages out. Safe versions added.
New advisory GHSA-2rwg (master key leak via Azure models): minimum raised to 1.106.9 / 1.108.6 / 1.109.1. Safe versions added.
Ubuntu 20.04 and 18.04 fixed through Ubuntu Pro. RHEL 10.3 fixed. kpatch coverage clarified. Safe versions added.
Cisco, Palo Alto and Fortinet appliance advisories added; PoC code for the memory corruption is public; Temurin Windows and Docker images still pending.
Corretto, Ubuntu and Debian fixes out; Temurin Windows and Docker images still pending. Oracle fixed builds now cited to Oracle. Safe versions added.
Electron sources corrected. ChromeOS 158 confirmed fixed. Safe versions added.
RHEL bundling corrected (Node 24 on RHEL 8/9 and .NET 8 carry their own copy). .NET 11.0.0 is out; .NET 8 and 9 reached end of life. Safe versions added.
Public crash PoC noted (no code execution). Singapore's CSA says reportedly exploited; others report no attacks. JBoss Core Services affected. Safe versions added.
Safe versions added; nothing else changed.
Review: directory-service accounts, Match blocks, and the CVE record's version and length range added.
Review: no fix as of 19 Nov; NEAR AI hasn't named the bug; /server_info leaks the admin key; docs conflict noted.
Review: Debian's patched packages, Puppet Enterprise versions sourced, read-only autosign check.
PHP's 19 Nov releases (8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37 or 8.2.36) are now the recommended update; exploit source and FPM detail added.
Rewritten after PHP's full advisory: no runtime switch needed, exploit demonstrated, verdict raised to Patch now if…
Review: wording matched to Microsoft's advisory; retail Office and Office 2019 builds noted.
Review: NGINX Plus R33–R36 (no fix), full HTTP/2 workaround, ASLR note, bundled-nginx sources.
Review: upgrade floor raised to 1.106.5 after newer admin-takeover advisories; Docker tag caveat.
Review: verdict set to Patch now if… (no public exploit or attacks), kpatch, correct listener check.
Review: Oracle's own fixed builds, Red Hat and Temurin fixes, GraalVM; 'disputed' note removed.
Added the CISA alert and Oracle's Java 8 Performance Pack exception.
Review: Electron's 10 Nov fix added (it was listed as unknown); more Edge builds; sandbox claim now cites CISA and the CVE record.
Review: full Envoy and Node version lists, RHEL system-library note, PHP for Windows, exploit caveat.
Review: exploit status set to demonstrated (Red Hat), mod_h2 versions, citations fixed.
Review: N-able confirmed attacks on 13 Nov; no CVE for the N-central step; claims matched to sources.
Public exploit released. No attacks seen.
Added to CISA KEV, due 2 Dec.
CVE-2026-90436 (Apache Axis) added to CISA KEV, due 21 Nov.
Added to CISA KEV. Verdict raised to Patch now.
N-able shipped 2026.4 HF3 (2026.4.1.39), which permanently blocks the Legacy API.
